## Overview

**J.B.** -- known only by these initials -- is a human crime lord in his 40s (at the time of Zan's childhood, now older) who ran a guild of thieves, assassins, and "ring bearers" on the Material Plane. He found a seven-year-old Zan on the streets and took him in -- not out of kindness, but as raw material to be shaped into a weapon.

---

## Background

### The False Savior

When Zan was abandoned on the Material Plane at age 7, with no memories of why, he spent months on the streets, stealing to survive. J.B. found him and presented a welcoming facade -- food, shelter, purpose. But J.B. was not an adoptive father. He was a master, and his guild was a training ground for young criminals.

### The Training

The rule was simple and cruel: if you messed up, you got beaten. The training was relentless, intense, and severe. Zan learned to steal, to kill, to disappear -- not because he wanted to, but because survival demanded it.

### The Mutilation

During a mission where a disguise threatened to fail, J.B. -- with brutal coldness -- cut off the tips of Zan's elven ears to force the disguise to hold. It was the first physical step in erasing Vaelis Zandorian.

### The Death of the Name

When Zan revealed his aristocratic surname, J.B. spat on his inheritance. His words still echo:

> *"You? Zandorion? You're just shit. Nothing... Now that you're talking about it, you're going to start being Zan, which goes against who you are."*

Vaelis died there. **Zan** was born. The Rest.

### The Sale

When Zan's innate Shadar-kai teleportation awakened at age 11 (during the 30-ft cliff jump when the Raven Queen answered), J.B. no longer saw a useful tool. He saw a **valuable commodity**. He sold Zan to the Flesh Architects -- the Covenant's research division -- for profit, without a second thought.

---

## Current Status

J.B.'s current whereabouts are unknown. He may still run his guild, or he may have moved on. Zan seeks to find him and settle the debt of blood and betrayal.

---

## Goals

1. Profit -- always profit
2. Acquire valuable assets (magical beings, rare items, useful information)
3. Stay alive and untouchable

---
